boundary_false_verdict.acceptance: Every applicable exact one-sided 95% upper false-verdict bound <=.025, including latent truths

calibration.acceptance: Every mandatory calibration feasible; residual <=1e-6; global count-weighted least-squares solution and complete truth

independent_validation.acceptance: First fully passing resampler only, 2000 fresh bank1 datasets/process and 5000 draws; same rules; failure stops

power.acceptance: Every mandatory designated reversal and all-zero/stable survival exact one-sided 95% lower power bound >=.80

validity.acceptance: Every |mean error|+1.96 MCSE <=.002; exact coverage lower bound >=.92; >=95% valid datasets, each >=4750/5000 joint draws and every SD>0; blocking fixtures emit no verdict

stop_reason: Required bias criterion fails in bank 0, process 3240; METHOD bars resampler fallback after bias failure
